cv.name: Rebecca Fenwick
cv.headline: ACCA Senior Accountant | Month-end, statutory accounts and audit
cv.summary: ACCA-qualified accountant with eight years across practice, food and drink manufacturing and the housing sector. I run the month-end close, prepare statutory accounts and look after the audit relationship.

experience.title: Senior Accountant
bullets: Lead the month-end close for a group with £140M turnover; close shortened from 9 to 6 working days
Prepare statutory accounts under FRS 102 and the Housing SORP
Main contact for external auditors and the audit committee papers

experience.title: Management Accountant
bullets: Monthly management accounts, stock valuation and margin analysis by product
Supported the move from Sage 200 to Xero

experience.title: Trainee Accountant
bullets: Year-end accounts, VAT returns and corporation tax computations for SME clients
